body: YouTube Music is adding three labels to the player page: fully AI-generated, partly AI-generated and no AI. Tapping a label explains what the model contributed.
AI-generated songs will stay eligible for monetization, a choice that will please creators using these tools and frustrate artists who wanted stricter limits.
dek: Tracks are tagged fully, partly or not AI-generated, and still earn money.
title: YouTube Music now labels AI-made songs
